options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of items to return

list.usage_instructions: Use `shopify items list` to list items. use `--limit/-l` to cap results (default 100); use `--filter/-f` for field-based filtering; use `--table/-t` for tabular output; use `--properties/-p` to limit returned fields.

get.help: Get details for a specific item.
get.usage_instructions: Use `shopify items get` to get details for a specific item. `ITEM_ID` is required and identifies the item id. use `--table/-t` for tabular output; use `--properties/-p` to limit returned fields.

search.help: Search items with wildcard pattern matching. Supports * wildcards for pattern matching across all string fields.
search.usage_instructions: Use `shopify items search` to search items with wildcard pattern matching. Supports * wildcards for pattern matching across all string fields. `QUERY` is required and identifies search query (supports * wildcards). use `--limit/-l` to cap results (default 100); use `--table/-t` for tabular output; use `--properties/-p` to limit returned fields; use `--fields` to restrict which fields are searched.

items.usage_instructions: Use `shopify items` for manage shopify items. Main actions: `items list`, `items get`, `items search`.

login.help: Configure authentication credentials. Prompts for required credentials based on the tool's authentication type. For OAuth authorization code flows, opens a browser for user consent.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to save credentials to

login.usage_instructions: Use `shopify auth login` to configure authentication credentials. Prompts for required credentials based on the tool's authentication type. For OAuth authorization code flows, opens a browser for user consent. use `--profile/-p` to target a specific auth profile; use `--force/-F` to skip confirmation or force re-authentication; use `--credential-type/-c` to authenticate only one credential type.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to clear credentials from

logout.usage_instructions: Use `shopify auth logout` to clear stored credentials. use `--profile/-p` to target a specific auth profile.

status.help: Check authentication status across profiles. Performs a live round-trip for every configured credential type so the report reflects ground truth — not on-disk belief. Saved credentials whose live verification fails are reported as ``authenticated: false`` with the failure reason in ``api_test``.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to check (defaults to all profiles)

status.usage_instructions: Use `shopify auth status` to check authentication status across profiles. Performs a live round-trip for every configured credential type so the report reflects ground truth — not on-disk belief. Saved credentials whose live verification fails are reported as ``authenticated: false`` with the failure reason in ``api_test``. use `--table/-t` for tabular output; use `--profile/-p` to target a specific auth profile.

test.help: Test authentication by verifying credentials work across profiles.
test.usage_instructions: Use `shopify auth test` to test authentication by verifying credentials work across profiles. use `--table/-t` for tabular output; use `--profile/-p` to target a specific auth profile; use `--verbose/-v` for detailed test output.

list.help: List all profiles and show their auth types and active state.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of profiles to return

options.name: --properties
options.help: Comma-separated list of fields to include

list.usage_instructions: Use `shopify auth profiles list` to list all profiles and show their auth types and active state. use `--limit/-l` to cap results; use `--filter/-f` for field-based filtering; use `--table/-t` for tabular output; use `--properties/-p` to limit returned fields.

get.help: Get details for a specific profile.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to get details for

get.usage_instructions: Use `shopify auth profiles get` to get details for a specific profile. `NAME` is required and identifies profile name to get details for. use `--table/-t` for tabular output.

create.help: Create a new profile from .env.example template.
create.usage_instructions: Use `shopify auth profiles create` to create a new profile from .env.example template. `NAME` is required and identifies profile name (e.g., staging, production).

select.help: Activate a profile within its auth type.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to activate within its auth type

select.usage_instructions: Use `auth profiles select NAME` to activate NAME within its auth type. Other auth types keep their active profiles unchanged.

delete.help: Delete a profile and its data.
delete.usage_instructions: Use `shopify auth profiles delete` to delete a profile and its data. `NAME` is required and identifies profile name to delete. use `--force/-F` to skip confirmation or force re-authentication.

remove.help: Delete a profile and its data.
remove.usage_instructions: Use `shopify auth profiles delete` to delete a profile and its data. `NAME` is required and identifies profile name to delete. use `--force/-F` to skip confirmation or force re-authentication.

profiles.usage_instructions: Use `shopify auth profiles` for manage authentication profiles. Main actions: `auth profiles list`, `auth profiles get`, `auth profiles create`, `auth profiles select`, `auth profiles delete`.

auth.usage_instructions: Use `shopify auth` for manage shopify authentication. Main actions: `auth login`, `auth logout`, `auth status`, `auth test`, `auth profiles`.

clear.help: Remove all cached responses. Deletes every file in the cache directory ({storage_dir}/cache/) and reports how many files and bytes were freed.
clear.usage_instructions: Use `shopify cache clear` to remove all cached responses. Deletes every file in the cache directory ({storage_dir}/cache/) and reports how many files and bytes were freed.

cache.usage_instructions: Use `shopify cache` for manage response cache. Main actions: `cache clear`.

usage_instructions: Use `shopify` for cLI interface for Shopify API. Commands follow `shopify <command-group> <action>`. Primary groups are items, auth, cache; `--no-cache` bypasses cached responses; `--version/-v` shows the installed CLI version.
